hero_kpi_rationale: Master indicator for the investment banking advisory services sector, directly reflecting demand for M&A transactions and financial restructuring services

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.description: Total revenues of the company, primarily generated by advisory services in mergers and acquisitions
kpis.signal: Revenue increase driven by business growth

kpis.name: International Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by the company's international operations
kpis.description: Revenues generated by the company's international activities from operations in the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Asia-Pacific
kpis.signal: Continuously increasing international revenues over three years

kpis.name: Employee Compensation Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of compensation and benefits expenses to total revenues
kpis.description: Compensation and benefits expenses as a percentage of total revenues (Employee Compensation and Benefits / Revenues = 1,524,268K / 2,389,416K)
kpis.signal: Stable compensation ratio despite revenue growth

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated after deduction of all operating expenses, before taxes and other income.
kpis.description: Operating income reached $501.5M for the fiscal year ended March 2025, up 38% vs $362.9M in 2024. This growth reflects operating leverage on revenue expansion.

kpis.name: CF Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total revenues generated by the Corporate Finance segment, an indicator of sector concentration.
kpis.description: The Corporate Finance segment represented 63.9% of total revenues in FY2025 ($1.53B out of $2.39B), compared to 57.8% in FY2024 ($1.11B out of $1.91B). The recovery in M&A markets amplifies this weight.

kpis.name: Non-Compensation Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of non-compensation expenses (IT, rent, amortization, fees) relative to total revenues.
kpis.description: Non-compensation expenses represented 15.2% of revenues in FY2025 ($363.6M / $2,389.4M), compared to 17.6% in FY2024 ($338.0M / $1,914.4M). The dilution of these fixed costs illustrates operating leverage.

kpis.name: Total Available Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Sum of unrestricted cash and marketable securities, reflecting the group's immediate financial capacity.
kpis.description: Unrestricted cash and marketable securities reached $1.17B as of March 31, 2025, compared to $759.2M a year earlier (+54%). This increase is driven by strong operating cash generation during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: CF Closed Deals
kpis.explanation: Number of transactions successfully completed in the Corporate Finance segment, a key M&A activity indicator.
kpis.description: The Corporate Finance segment closed 564 transactions in FY2025 versus 450 in FY2024, a 25% increase. This record volume reflects the recovery in M&A markets and directly supports segment revenue growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.6 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.165B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 41.3% in the latest year.

kpis.signal: Revenue increase driven by business growth
